sourceReview.reason: Fresh November 21 research found no issuer primary release or two independent full-text reports validating Franklin Templeton nearly $4B in tokenized T-bill holdings on November 19. Guardian's November 19 full report (https://guardian.security/blog/tokenized-treasuries-explained/) cites November 6 RWA.xyz data: iBENJI $1.71B and BENJI $1.16B (different products), and total tokenized Treasury distributed value $14.24B. A November 19 HokaNews report (https://www.hokanews.com/2026/11/bnb-chain-overtakes-ethereum-in.html) cites roughly $14.2B market value but calls Franklin Benji share 22.7%, not nearly $4B verified issuer holdings. These are not sufficient independent substantiation of the exact headline, especially for November 19. Do not publish; retry no earlier than six hours after reviewedAt.
